summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on June 16, 2026, announcing the unveiling of its full-form EAI Robot World product series, a three-in-one robotics education ecosystem, and a new humanoid robot priced at $1,990. The filing is a routine press release disclosure of product launches and strategic initiatives, not a special situation event. It contains no M&A, capital return, restructuring, or other special-situations activity. The registrant is acting solely as an issuer reporting ordinary business developments via a furnished Form 8-K.
